inputs.text: [excited] Al… bur… toh… saurus. [curious] "Alberto" comes from Alberta, a BIG region of Canada where its bones were found. [playful] And "saurus," you know what that means?
[happily] Exactly. [amazed] It lived there, seventy million years ago. [warmly] A cousin of T. rex.
[curious] Did it have enemies? [nervous] Hunters even tougher than it?
[confident] No. [warmly] In its own country, it was the biggest hunter around. [proud] No other carnivore was big enough to mess with it.
